intro: NIVO reads this mailbox and nothing else: it never sends, moves, flags or deletes a message.
fieldNameHint: A label only you see, for example Support mailbox.
fieldUserHint: Usually the same as the email address.
passwordHint: Gmail and Outlook do not accept your normal password here. Turn on 2-Step Verification, create an app password named NIVO and paste it. The password is stored encrypted and never shown again.
passwordKeep: Leave blank to keep the saved password.
imapOn: IMAP must be turned on in the mailbox settings. In Gmail: Settings, Forwarding and POP/IMAP, Enable IMAP.
guideGmail: Gmail: open Google Account, Security, App passwords, create one named NIVO and paste its 16 characters. App passwords need 2-Step Verification.
guideOutlook: Outlook or Office 365: create an app password in your Microsoft account security settings. A work account may need the admin to allow IMAP sign-in.
guideZoho: Zoho: with two-factor sign-in on, create an app password in Zoho Accounts, Security, App passwords.
guideYahoo: Yahoo: create an app password in Account security, Generate app password.
guideOther: Ask your mail provider for the IMAP server, port and whether it needs an app password.
starttlsWarn: STARTTLS starts unencrypted and upgrades; NIVO refuses to continue if the server does not upgrade. Choose TLS on port 993 when you can.
testStale: The settings changed. Check the connection again.
foldersHint: INBOX is ticked by default. Pick other folders if you want them too.
sinceTitle: How far back on the first sync
sinceHint: Only mail from this period is read the first time; after that, only new mail.
scheduleHint: How often NIVO looks for new mail.
agentSaved: The mailbox is saved. New mail appears after the first sync.
